newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end higher as yen tumbles.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end higher as yen tumbles.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures extended early gains to end higher across the board on Tuesday, lifted by short-covering as the dollar hit a fresh 50-month high of 126.12 yen in Tokyo trade, traders said.
Rubber prices ranged from 1.5 yen to 2.8 yen per kg higher. Benchmark September was up 2.4 yen at 145.6 yen.

"The dollar's gains stimulated short-covering after rubber prices fell in recent days," one analyst at a commodity brokerage said. Traders said the topside was likely to be pressured by profit taking if overseas markets continue to be weaker on slack demand.
